lending.debicheck_desc: Take control of your debit orders
lending.debicheck_intro: Thank you for setting up your debit order details. Your bank requires us to verify that you are in agreement with the details captured.
lending.debicheck_sms_note: This means you will receive an SMS directly from your bank, to the mobile number you have registered with your bank. The process is simple; just follow the instructions on your mobile.

debicheck.step_1_desc: You may either receive a USSD pop-up on your cell phone’s screen OR an SMS alerting you to authorise your DebiCheck debit order (depending on which bank manages your account).
debicheck.step_2_desc: Follow the instructions in the notification to authorise your new debit order.
debicheck.step_3_desc: If you don’t receive the pop-up menu or the notification now, you can still continue with our application process. Alternatively, you can visit your bank’s website for more information.

lending.debicheck_deadline_desc: You will have until {{time}} this evening to approve the debit order on your cellphone or banking app.
lending.debicheck_disclaimer_1: We may make use of a Registered Mandate Service (RMS) in the case of a technical failure to deliver the notification or in the event of us not receiving a response after the mandate initiation for your authorisation has expired.
lending.debicheck_disclaimer_2: In these instances, you may receive a new notification from your bank to inform you of the successful registration of your DebiCheck mandate.
lending.restructure_note: This will create a Loan Restructure document, officially changing the repayment schedule and contract terms.
